comparison: RQ2 ablation, Table 4 (Int-1 C# migration): CodePlan with vs without temporal+spatial (dependency-graph-derived) context. Alternative considered: Table 3 CodePlan vs Build-Repair/Pyright-Repair (oracle-guided localisation, same context method).

budget_control: not reported (no token counts or prompt-length caps for either arm)
arm_a: CodePlan prompt with temporal context (prior related edits from plan graph) and spatial context (related code from the dependency graph), plus class-sketch fragment
arm_b: Same prompt without temporal or spatial context (fragment + instruction only)

comparison: Table 1: Observation Masking vs Raw Agent (and vs LLM-Summary), SWE-agent, Qwen3-Coder 480B
model_config: Same agent model, temperature 0.8, SWE-agent scaffold, 250-turn limit in all arms. LLM-Summary additionally calls a summarizer LLM (temperature 0).
dataset_metric: SWE-bench Verified (500); solve rate, instance cost ($)
budget_control: Not held as a control; realized per-instance cost reported (outcome). Masking arm is cheaper than Raw: $0.61 vs $1.29 (-52.7%); LLM-Summary $0.64. Cost in USD, not raw token counts.
arm_a: Observation Masking: observations older than M=10 turns replaced by placeholders; reasoning/actions kept
arm_b: Raw Agent: full unmanaged trajectory history
other_changes: Masking vs Raw: none (trajectory length varies as an outcome). Masking vs LLM-Summary: summary arm adds extra summarizer LLM calls ('direct API cost of generating summaries accounts for up to 7.2%') and elongates trajectories.
delta: Qwen3-Coder 480B solve rate 54.8% vs 53.4% (Raw, +2.6% rel.) at -52.7% cost; LLM-Summary 53.8%. Across models masking ranges -11.8% to +8.5% rel. vs Raw.
rationale: Masking vs Raw changes only the context-management mechanism in the same model and scaffold, and the treatment arm consumes less realized budget: 'Observation Masking is not only 52% cheaper than the Raw Agent'. Budget is measured as realized $ cost, not a token cap. The masking vs LLM-Summary contrast would be multi-change because of the extra summarizer calls.

comparison: Agent (bash-only mini-SWE-agent) vs Agent + CCE toolkit, GPT-5 Mini on ReCUBE-large (Table 6 APR, Table 7 cost). Same contrast on ReCUBE (Table 5), where CCE costs slightly more.

arm_a: Agent with Caller-Centric Exploration tools over a dependency graph (caller patterns, call hierarchy, similar files, programmatic graph queries)
